name: Supply of School Stationery, Socks, Shoes, School Bag, etc. to all Students of Std I to VIII
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit:
1. Reduces financial burden on parents by providing a comprehensive school kit.
2. Provision of free stationery kits includes school bag, pairs of socks, school shoes and a complete stationery set (notebooks, pens/pencils etc).
3. Providing shoes and socks promotes better foot health and hygiene for students commuting to school.
4. Promotes regular school attendance by supporting foundational need

all.value: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a student. 2. The applicant should be studying in class 1st to 8th. 3. The applicant should be studying in a government school in UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.
